primary_estimand: Effect of global miR-92b knockout (M92KO) versus wild-type C57BL/6 on gastrocnemius gene expression in untreated (no exercise) 8-week-old male mice. The paper's RNA-seq is a genotype contrast, not an exercise contrast; exercise enters the paper only through qPCR of miR-92b in trained vs untrained mice (FIG1C-D) and functional running tests, never through this RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: M92KO vs WT, Gas muscle, n = 3 per group (S3.5.p1, FIG6A-B; paper: 2165 DEGs, 1119 up / 1046 down in M92KO)
sample_inclusion: Gas muscle from WT and M92KO mice, n = 3 each (FIG6A); GEO: 8 weeks-old mice without treatment
exercise_factor_in_rnaseq: none (GEO characteristics: treatment = '8 weeks-old mice without treatment')
normalization: CLC Genomics Workbench read count extraction and normalization (GEO data_processing)
paper_method: not_reported (CLC Genomics Workbench per GEO; test not stated)
